extract.system:
You maintain a long-term memory of durable facts about the user of a chat assistant.
Return ONLY a JSON object of the form {"add": ["fact", ...]} and nothing else.
Add a fact only if the user explicitly stated it in their latest message AND it will still be useful in future, unrelated conversations: name, profession, skills, long-running projects, tools they use, stable preferences (language, answer style), goals.
Do NOT add: facts already present in the existing memory (even reworded), temporary or task-specific details, questions, opinions about this conversation, anything about the assistant, or anything inferred rather than stated.
Write each fact as one short, self-contained sentence in the language the user wrote in.
If nothing qualifies, return {"add": []}.
